text:
You need a long-term reel video creator who can study each topic, tell a meaningful story, take feedback well, and deliver 2 engaging AI-generated reels every day.

Hi, I’m Noor Halden. I have 6 years of experience working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, and I’m interested in bringing that same structured, iterative approach to AI-generated reel production.

What stands out to me in your post is the combination of speed and quality: each reel needs to be meaningful, story-driven, and engaging, while also being made consistently and refined based on feedback. That kind of workflow fits well with how I approach complex content tasks — research first, then build a clear narrative, then improve through revision.

In a telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. The result was an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and 3.1x top-decile lift. That project taught me how to take a dense subject, identify what matters, and present it in a way people can quickly understand — a useful skill when turning information into short-form video stories.

In another project for Tidewater Outfitters, I built similar items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis. That work improved click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test. It also reinforced how important relevance, pacing, and presentation are when you want content to keep people watching and clicking.

For your TikTok reels, I’d focus on studying each topic carefully, shaping a clear hook and narrative, and iterating quickly based on your feedback. I’m comfortable working closely with a team and adapting the content direction as needed so the reels stay aligned with your goals and publishing style.

I’d be glad to share my AI-generated reel video examples and discuss how you want the daily workflow and revision process to work. What topics or niches will the first batch of reels cover?
